name: ColorZilla
summary: Eyedropper-and-picker suite that reads any pixel on the page, copies the value in several formats, and adds a gradient editor and a page-wide color analyzer.
license: Proprietary; no open-source license stated on the store page.
goodFor: Picking any color from the page and copying it in several formats.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: color picker eyedropper gradient analyzer palette
